faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes Vario 614D/615D use?
faqLeft.a: It uses either the OM612 or OM647 diesel engine, both fitted across the 1996-2013 production run. Both are 2.2L to 2.7L units shared with the equivalent-era Sprinter. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your van has.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes Vario 614D/615D engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,300, for either engine code. Exact price depends on condition and parts required - submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Vario 614D/615D?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the OM612 or the OM647 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild OM612 Vario 614D/615D engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chain components, timing gears, injector seals and gaskets as standard on every OM612 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild OM647 Vario 614D/615D engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chain components, timing gears, injector seals and gaskets as standard on every OM647 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Vario 614D/615D engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Vario 614D/615D if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes - nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Vario 614D/615D engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your van arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Vario 614D/615D owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty - often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
